title: AreTomo3, community-maintained build (kyledent/AreTomo3)
description:
Community build, not an official AreTomo3 release. This archive is a release of the kyledent/AreTomo3 fork of czimaginginstitute/AreTomo3. The AreTomo3 authors did not produce or review it. The AreTomo3 algorithms are upstream's.

The fork adds build fixes (makefile source lists, position-independent support libraries, Blackwell GPU targets), continuous integration, and release tooling.

AI disclosure (Claude-CoI). The fork's changes were prepared with the assistance of Claude (Anthropic), an AI model, and released by the fork's maintainer.

To cite AreTomo3 itself, cite Peck et al. (2026), Nature Methods, doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03093-y.
notes: Tag scheme v<upstream version>-community-Claude-CoI.<n>. Binaries and a container image for each release are on the GitHub release page and GHCR, not in this archive.
